_comment: Look slice props (PROPS builder, art/lookslice/props/place.mjs). baked: true = static, the arch bake imports glb (clean.glb, Blender-readable) and ships it lightmapped; baked: false = placed live by src/lookslice/dressing.ts. pos = base centre in game coords (m, x east, y up, z south); yaw radians about +y; tilt [x, z] radians after yaw (Euler YXZ); collide = box half-extents standing on pos (yaw applied) or null; size = model w,h,d in m. Cloth pos is its hang point (top centre).
